Good questions

How do I order?

Fill in the order form below, or call (514) 555-0148.

Do you cater?

Yes — events from 20 people. Ask via the order form: pick “Catering” and tell us the date and the headcount.

When do you sell out?

Often by Saturday evening. Order ahead if you want to be sure.

Anything without meat?

Yes — the sides and salads are vegetarian.
